name: power-diode
title: Power Diode (PoC)
author: cindra
description: Standalone proof-of-concept: a 'power diode' that transfers electricity ONE WAY between two otherwise-isolated electric networks. Energy flows A->B up to a configurable rate cap and NEVER B->A. Bridges two networks with a scripted buffer pair (input accumulator on net A, output accumulator on net B). This later enables topologies like capacitor-dumps-into-battery where power must not flow back.
